environment.description: Same application deployed behind an internal NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private subnet (10.128.0.0/20). The NLB target group has a preserve_client_ip=false setting. Upstream traffic is routed exclusively through a VPC PrivateLink endpoint from a shared-services VPC. The NLB security group (sg-0a3f8e91c) restricts ingress to three specific CIDR blocks: 10.200.4.0/24 (CI/CD runners), 10.200.8.0/25 (internal monitoring), and 172.16.99.0/28 (SRE bastion hosts). The EC2 instance security group (sg-0b7c2d44a) only allows ingress from the NLB security group on TCP/3000. No internet gateway or NAT gateway is attached to the private subnet's route table. VPC flow logs confirm no external source IPs have reached the instance in 90 days of operation. DNS resolution for the service is only available via Route53 private hosted zone (stream-proc.internal.corp).

config.instance_security_group: sg-0b7c2d44a ingress from sg-0a3f8e91c only tcp/3000
config.dns: Route53 private hosted zone, no public resolution
